messages:
Priya (Mktg): Heads up — we need final social plan for the 'Inference Unlocked' webinar tomorrow. X + LinkedIn primary push, thread on X, and 2 follow-up posts for registrants. Can we lock assets and posting windows today? Link: https://redwood.example/webinar/inference-unlocked
Marco (Design): I can do hero image + 30s clip + 1 slide. What sizes/copy should I optimize for? Do you want square for carousels?
Priya (Mktg): Thanks Marco — square + 16:9 clip. Caption copy below, but we need an alternative headline for A/B. Also add a second frame to the clip with the CTA.
Jody (Growth): For timing, recommend X: 10:30am PT (announcement), 2:00pm PT (reminder), LinkedIn: 11:00am PT. Thread should go out 10:35am PT. Can ops schedule? Also need UTM params.
Noah (Analytics): Use utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_unlocked_2026&utm_content={variant}
Samira (Content): Caption A: "Inference Unlocked: How to serve LLMs faster and cheaper — join our engineers + customers. Register → https://redwood.example/webinar/inference-unlocked"
Samira (Content): Caption B: "Want predictable LLM latency at scale? See our playbook and benchmarks. Free webinar — sign up: https://redwood.example/webinar/inference-unlocked"
Priya (Mktg): Great — Marco, include overlay text for both headlines so we can A/B test. Also need a short thread outline for X: 4 tweets — tease, benchmark stat, customer quote, CTA. Samira can drop the 4 bullets.
Samira (Content): Thread outline: 1) Hook: "Latency is a product feature." 2) Stat: "60% cost reduction vs naive serving" 3) Quick tech note: "prefix KV caching + batching" 4) CTA + link. I'll draft microcopy now.
Marco (Design): ETA for assets = 4pm PT. Will push to Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/inference-unlocked-assets
Evan (Sales): If registrants ask for enterprise demos, can we route leads to SDR queue with priority tag? Need Zapier sheet mapping + who owns follow-up.
Priya (Mktg): Yes — high-intent form field = "request-demo". Evan, team will get immediate Slack ping + create lead in Salesforce. Noah, can you confirm tracking event?
Noah (Analytics): Adding event 'webinar_reg' with property 'interest: demo'. I'll publish mapping before 5pm PT.
Jody (Growth): Ops — Socialbot, please schedule the posts: X announce 10:30 PT, X thread 10:35 PT, LinkedIn 11:00 PT, reminder X 2:00 PT. Use Caption A as default, Caption B for the thread CTA variant.
Socialbot: Scheduled posts created: job# 79211. First post set for 1765440600 (10:30am PT). Thread scheduled for 1765440900. Will post from @redwoodinc and attach UTM.
Marco (Design): Uploaded assets to Figma + exported PNGs and MP4 in the 'exports' page. Small change — need final CTA copy to render on the clip frame.
Priya (Mktg): CTA = "Register free — seats limited". Marco, use white text with 48px, button color #ff6a00.
Evan (Sales): Also add a note in the confirmation email to route "request-demo" > SDRs. Who's owning the mapping doc?
Priya (Mktg): I'll own the doc. Creating sheet and will share link here in 15.
Priya (Mktg): Sheets link: https://docs.example/sheets/inference-unlocked-routing — columns: email, demo_flag, sdr_owner, region.
Samira (Content): Quick ask: can we pin a follow-up LinkedIn post 24h after webinar with the recording + key slides? That would help inbound capture.
Jody (Growth): Yes pin + retargeting ad pool. I'll set the 24h follow-up as a separate job after we get the recording.
Noah (Analytics): Reminder: add tracking for 'watch_recording' event and UTM for the replay link.
Marco (Design): All exports done and attached in Figma. Sending final PNGs now.
Priya (Mktg): Perfect — thanks team. Last thing: Evan, will SDRs get a daily digest or immediate ping?
Evan (Sales): Immediate ping + daily digest at 4pm PT. Prioritize demo_flag=high.
Priya (Mktg): OK locking this. If no objections, we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
Samira (Content): Drafted thread copy and variations, pasted into the sheet.
Jody (Growth): Confirmed scheduling in the campaign calendar.
Noah (Analytics): Mapping published.
Socialbot: Post job#79211 executed successfully for announcement (1765440600).
Priya (Mktg): Thanks everyone — callout to @Marco for the quick turnaround. We'll monitor engagement and report tomorrow morning. :rocket:
